item.title: About me
item.description:
I’m a Sound Engineer with a background in Sound and Music Computing and a PhD in Computer Science.

My research interests lie at the intersection of speech and hearing technologies, audio signal processing and machine learning, sonification and audio AI in healthcare. I’m interested in exploring interdisciplinary approaches to address current global challenges under a framework of responsible research and innovation.

Content:

  • The research section focuses on my Postdoc and PhD experiences. They have resources to datasets, papers, scripts and any other research outputs I’ve contributed to.
